detail: Searching for Node.js latest LTS version October 2026

content.content:
Web search results for query: "Node.js latest LTS version October 2026"

Links: [{"title":"# nodejs-latest","url":"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/nodejs-latest@1.1.0/README.md"},{"title":"Get Node.js LTS versions","url":"https://npmjs.com/package/nodejs-lts-versions"},{"title":"What are LTS Versions of Node.js: A Detailed Guide","url":"https://codeforgeek.com/?p=31474"},{"title":"What are LTS Versions of Node.js: A Detailed Guide","url":"https://codeforgeek.com/nodejs-lts-versions/"},{"title":"nodejs latest","url":"https://www.npmjs.com/package/nodejs-latest"},{"title":"Update Node.js LTS to v20.19.0","url":"https://cdn04132025.gitlink.org.cn/louis_lifu/continue/commit/1db5144b28a66fe37a808a78415498460f3e4240"},{"title":"What are LTS versions of Node.js ?","url":"https://geeksforgeeks.org/what-are-lts-versions-of-node-js"},{"title":"Open In App","url":"https://geeksforgeeks.org/node-js-versions"},{"title":"Node.js-Releases, Versionen und End-of-Life-Termine (EOL)","url":"https://www.versio.io/de/product-release-end-of-life-eol-openjs-foundation-nodejs.html"}]

The search didn't turn up an official Node.js source for October 2026, so treat these results as indicative only. The most useful one is a versio.io page, last updated 16 September 2026, which lists Node 26 (released 2026-05-05) with latest version 26.8.2 dated 2026-09-09, marked as LTS. Node 24 (Krypton) at 24.21.0 and Node 22 (Jod) at 22.23.2 are also marked LTS.

Node 26 is flagged as LTS on that page. Node.js normally promotes an even-numbered release to LTS in October, so that status may be an early listing, and I couldn't confirm it against nodejs.org. The other results are older guides or package READMEs, such as a 2024 GeeksforGeeks article, and don't reflect the current release line.

Recommended next step: check nodejs.org/en/about/previous-releases for the current LTS designation before relying on this.
